අංක 2462/34 – 2025 ෙනʣවැȼබə මස 14 වැǧ ʆýරාදා – 2025.11.14No. 2462/34 – FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 14, 2025
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk

“THE Hon. Governor of Uva Province has issued Gazette Extraordinary No. 2318/41 dated 10th February, 2023 and Gazette Extraordinary No. 2414/13 dated 11th December, 2024, which is maintained by the Pradeshiya Sabha of Uva Province. Under the provisions of the ‘Regulations on the preparation of plans and publication of notices indicating the names of roads and narrow roads’ series and the provisions of Section 24(1) of the Pradeshiya Sabha Act, No. 15 of 1987, published in the Gazette No. 2438/44 dated 29th May, 2025. Among the roads and narrow roads considered to be owned by the Moneragala Pradeshiya Sabha in the schedule included in the notiﬁ cation published in the newspaper, the roads and narrow roads speciﬁ ed in the said notiﬁ cation Roads and narrow roads for which no case has been ﬁ led in a competent court before that date and for which a case has been ﬁ led in a competent court before that date and which are deemed to be owned by the Pradeshiya Sabha in accordance with the decisions given by that court. It is hereby published for the information of the public that it has been passed under Resolution No. (E) 08 of the General Assembly held on 24th October, 2025 that all roads and narrow paths shall be owned by the Moneragala Pradeshiya Sabha.

A list of such roads and byways is included in the Schedule hereto. It is further announced that every roads and narrow path included therein shall be deemed to be the roads and narrow paths owned by the Moneragala Pradeshiya Sabha under Sub-section (5) of Section 24 of the Local Government Act. U. K. M. J. P. Kඎඋඎඉඉඎ, Chairman, Moneragala Pradeshiya Sabha. At the Moneragala Pradeshiya Sabha,31st October, 2025.

“THE Hon. Governor of Uva Province has issued the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2318/41 dated 10th February, 2023 and in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2414/13 dated 11th December, 2024. The regulations made in the series “Regulations on the preparation of plans and publication of notices indicating the names of the roads and lanes maintained by the Local Council in the Uva Province” which have been published and according to Section 24(1) of the Local Council Act, No. 15 of 1987, after being Gazette for the ﬁ rst time under the resolution No. 217 dated 26the March 2025, Moneragala Local Council held on 24th October 2025, No. (E) 08 of the General Meeting of the in accordance with the provisions of Section 9:3 of the Local Council Act, under the order made by the section. According to the decision of the competent court, from among the roads and narrow roads listed in the schedule to the notiﬁ cation published in the Gazette on 29th May 2025. The Moneragala Local Council proposes that the roads and narrow roads that have not been sued and are included in the schedule below be conﬁ rmed as roads and narrow roads owned by the Moneragala Local Council.
